parts.args:
{"source":"data","name":"paid_order_amount_by_region","sql":"SELECT customers.region, SUM(orders.amount) AS total_paid_order_amount
FROM orders
JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE orders.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY customers.region"}
